rationale: Exactly 12 strokes (the limit), one width, 75% coverage: twelve 2px verticals 1.5px apart. At 16px the gaps are 0.33 device px and the icon is a grey slab. The element limit is a count, not a density; a check should measure the minimum centre-to-centre distance between parallel strokes minus the stroke width (gap) at must_read_at and require >= 1 device px.
